test.name: Spec 0010 spike: proc_pidpath equals the canonical executable path

expected: proc_pidpath returns the canonical path of the executable inside the runtime root, for a suspended child and for a non-child, whatever spelling of the path was spawned (spec 0010 AC-9, Adapter macOS row Executable)
actual: The darwin user temp folder is /var/folders/..., which canonicalizes to /private/var/folders/...; proc_pidpath of the suspended child and of the non-child orphan both equal fs::canonicalize of the runtime executable (/private/var/.../Test Root Ünï cödé/runtime/fake/0.1.0/aarch64-apple-darwin/0f1e2d3c/bin/stackly-fake-server), equal to what the old daemon recorded. Spawned through the /var spelling: canonical /private/var path returned. Spawned through a symlink: the target is returned, while KERN_PROCARGS2 argv[0] stays the link path. Spawned through an NFD spelling of the NFC folder name: the stored NFC name is returned (176 bytes, not 180). Executable renamed while the process lives: proc_pidpath reports the new name; after unlink: ENOENT. So the recorded path must be the canonical path (as spec 0010 says) and a moved or deleted runtime never matches by accident. Absent and zombie pids: ESRCH. pid 1 (root): /sbin/launchd.
steps: Checked out d99e5ea (clean) in worktree f10-spike-a90e60 on this Mac (macOS 27.0 build 26A428, arm64, Apple Silicon, page size 16384).
cargo build -p stackly-fake-server --locked; the child in every scenario is target/debug/stackly-fake-server (or /bin/sh and /bin/sleep where a process group or a descendant is needed).

Built the throwaway spike outside the workspace: spike-main.rs.txt as src/main.rs and spike-Cargo.toml.txt as Cargo.toml (libc =0.2.190, the workspace's version, plus serde_json), cargo build --offline --release. Source, full run log, and the extra experiments are in the evidence folder of the first record of this set (title 'Spec 0010 spike: posix_spawn flags, fd map, argv, env, cwd').

Ran `spike0010 run target/debug/stackly-fake-server 60`. Test root under the darwin user temp folder (confstr _CS_DARWIN_USER_TEMP_DIR) at stackly-spike0010-<pid>/Test Root Ünï cödé, fake runtime copied to runtime/fake/0.1.0/aarch64-apple-darwin/0f1e2d3c/bin/stackly-fake-server and spawned by its canonical path, data and instance.lock under data/instances/<name>/, spools under run/i/<name>/. Every spawned pid was registered and killed or reaped at the end; the run's cleanup check found no leftover process, and the test root was removed.
Rows checked by the [exe] lines of output.txt: suspended child, orphan, /var spelling, symlink, NFD spelling, rename and unlink of a copied executable, absent pid, pid 1.
